position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode enum selects sizing method: LOT=fixed lot (MM value=lot size), FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss. When MMMode=LOT, MM=0.1 means 0.1 lots fixed

custom_logic_notes: Entry signal uses previous bar values (SignalBar=1 by default, checking Ind[1] vs Sign[1] for trend direction and Ind[0] vs Sign[0] for crossover confirmation). The HullTrend indicator is a custom indicator loaded via iCustom with 2 buffers: buffer 0 is the main Hull line, buffer 1 is the signal line. Signal logic: when Ind[1]>Sign[1] (trend is up) AND Ind[0]<=Sign[0] (crossover just happened), a BUY signal fires. Conversely for SELL. The Recount flag causes re-evaluation on next tick if CopyBuffer fails. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose input toggles independently control whether each signal type is acted upon. Signal timestamp is calculated as SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE + TimeShiftSec for trade function timing.
python_conversion_notes: The HullTrend custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python. It uses the CXMA class from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh which implements 10+ smoothing methods (SMA, EMA, SMMA, LWMA, JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA). The HullTrend calculation is: HMA = LWMA(sqrt(period), LWMA(period, price*2) - LWMA(period, price)). The default method is LWMA but any of the 10 methods can be substituted. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose wrappers which handle position counting, margin calculation, and order placement - these must be reimplemented or replaced with a standard Python broker API. The MMMode enum provides 5 money management modes that must all be supported. Signal bar index is configurable (SignalBar input), default 1 means signals are evaluated on the previous completed bar.
